# Metric reference

Every series below is published with the `cube_` prefix by default (`CUBE_METRICS_PREFIX`).
Durations are in **seconds**; Cube reports milliseconds and the exporter converts.

## Series

| Metric | Type | Labels | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `cube_events_total` | counter | `event`, `api_type` | Cube logger events, labelled by event name and API type |
| `cube_event_duration_seconds` | histogram | `event` | Duration Cube reported for an event, in seconds |
| `cube_requests_total` | counter | `api_type`, `status` | Data API requests by API type and outcome |
| `cube_request_duration_seconds` | histogram | `api_type` | Load request duration reported by Cube, in seconds |
| `cube_requests_in_flight` | gauge | `api_type` | Load requests currently in flight, tracked by request id |
| `cube_db_queries_total` | counter | `status` | Queries issued to the data source by outcome |
| `cube_db_query_duration_seconds` | histogram | — | Data source query duration reported by Cube, in seconds |
| `cube_queue_wait_seconds` | histogram | — | Time a query spent waiting in the orchestrator queue |
| `cube_cache_requests_total` | counter | `outcome` | Cache lookups by outcome |
| `cube_preaggregation_served_total` | counter | — | Load requests served with at least one pre-aggregation |
| `cube_preaggregation_builds_total` | counter | `status` | Pre-aggregation build executions by outcome |
| `cube_preaggregation_build_duration_seconds` | histogram | — | Pre-aggregation build execution duration in seconds |
| `cube_sql_generation_duration_seconds` | histogram | — | Time Cube spent compiling the model and generating SQL |
| `cube_build_info` | gauge | `version`, `db_type`, `cache_driver` | Constant 1, labelled with the exporter build identity |
| `cube_telemetry_dropped_total` | counter | `reason` | Telemetry operations dropped, by reason |
| `cube_telemetry_unmapped_events_total` | counter | `event` | Logger events outside the exporter contract (drift detector) |

Runtime families from `collectDefaultMetrics` are published under the same prefix:
- `cube_process_cpu_seconds_total`
- `cube_process_resident_memory_bytes`
- `cube_process_heap_bytes`
- `cube_nodejs_heap_size_used_bytes`
- `cube_nodejs_heap_size_total_bytes`
- `cube_nodejs_eventloop_lag_seconds`
- `cube_nodejs_gc_duration_seconds`

Cube Store publishes its own `cs_*` families through `statsd_exporter`; they are not
part of this catalog and are documented by the Cube Store chart.

## Event mapping

Cube event names are the ABI. `make test-contract` verifies each one against a Cube
checkout, and `tools/gen.mjs` builds the dashboards from the same table.

| Family | Events | Effect |
| --- | --- | --- |
| requestStarted | `Load Request` | requests_in_flight +1, events_total |
| requestSucceeded | `Load Request Success` | requests_total{status="success"}, request_duration_seconds, preaggregation_served_total |
| requestFailed | `UserError`, `Orchestrator error`, `Internal Server Error`, `Cube SQL Error`, `Error querying db` | requests_total{status="error"}, requests_in_flight -1 |
| requestContinued | `Continue wait` | events_total only (a load spans several HTTP attempts) |
| dbSucceeded | `Query completed` | db_queries_total{status="success"}, db_query_duration_seconds |
| dbFailed | `Error querying db` | db_queries_total{status="error"} |
| queueCompleted | `Performing query completed` | queue_wait_seconds, and preaggregation_builds_total + build_duration_seconds when preAggregationId is set |
| queueFailed | `Error while querying` | preaggregation_builds_total{status="error"} when preAggregationId is set |
| sqlGenerated | `Load Request SQL` | sql_generation_duration_seconds |
| schedulerRun | `Refresh Scheduler Run` | events_total, used by the refresh heartbeat alert |
| schedulerFailed | `Refresh Scheduler Error` | events_total, used by the refresh alerts |
| preaggregationBuildStarted | `Force build pre-aggregation` | events_total |
| preaggregationBuildFailed | `Pre-aggregations build job error`, `Error loading pre-aggregation` | events_total |

## Cache outcomes

Only the terminal event of a lookup is counted, so the hit ratio is not inflated by
precursor events such as `Found cache entry`.

| Event | `outcome` label |
| --- | --- |
| `Using cache for` | `hit` |
| `Missing cache for` | `miss` |
| `Force no cache for` | `bypass` |

## Deliberate omissions

- No query text, SQL, request id, tenant or cache key in any label.
- No `status` label on HTTP requests: Cube logs the request before the handler runs,
  so a reliable status code needs a core change (tracked upstream).
- No queue depth gauge: Cube logs queue size only at enqueue time, which over-reports
  after a burst drains. `Continue wait` ratio and `queue_wait_seconds` are the honest
  saturation signals available today.

## Drift detection

`cube_telemetry_unmapped_events_total{event}` increments when Cube emits an event the
contract does not know. The `CubeTelemetryUnmappedEvents` alert fires on it, which is
the signal to run the `cube-upstream-contract` skill after a Cube upgrade.
